arguments.summary: The helper manually increments date.day and falls back to day 1 of the same month, so every month-end, year-end, and leap-day rollover is wrong.

findings.claim: The month-end branch replaces only the day, preserving the original month and year instead of advancing one calendar day.

recommendations: Replace the manual month-end branch with value + timedelta(days=1), then rerun the tests.
